markdown.markdown:
Welcome to the course website for **ECN 4199: Industrial Data Analytics**.

This course introduces students to:

- Python programming
- data analytics
- data visualisation
- machine learning
- forecasting
- AI tools for economics and business
- interactive dashboards
- text analytics

The course is designed for students with little or no prior programming experience.

You are not expected to become a computer scientist.

You are expected to become an economist who can work effectively with modern data tools.

---

# How This Website Works

This website is the main learning platform for the course.

Each week, students should:

1. Read the weekly lesson page
2. Open the live coding notebook
3. Follow the lecture activity
4. Complete the self-assessment
5. Submit the weekly task

---

# Course Learning Progression

| Weeks | Focus |
|---|---|
| Weeks 1–3 | Python foundations |
| Weeks 4–6 | Data handling and visualisation |
| Weeks 7–9 | Regression and machine learning |
| Weeks 10–11 | Clustering and forecasting |
| Week 12 | AI and text analytics |
| Week 13 | Final integrated project |

---

# Course Workflow

## During lectures

Students will use:

- this website
- Google Colab notebooks
- datasets provided on the website

## After lectures

Students will complete:

- coding exercises
- self-assessment tasks
- mini projects
- interpretation activities

---

# Important Note

This course focuses on practical analytical thinking.

The objective is not memorising code.

The objective is learning how to:

- solve problems with data
- interpret evidence
- communicate findings
- use AI critically and responsibly

---

# Navigation Guide

Use the navigation menu at the top of the website:

- **Course Roadmap** → overall course structure
- **Setup Guide** → how to use Colab and Python tools
- **Week 1** → first lecture materials
- **Datasets** → datasets for practical exercises
- **Notebooks** → live coding notebooks
- **Submissions** → assignment and notebook submissions

---

# Recommended Starting Point

Students should begin with:

1. Setup Guide
2. Week 1 lesson
3. Week 1 live notebook
